properties.label: Dissolving feature trio
properties.text: Arrange three pale feature scenes whose image areas dissolve into their text areas, using floating fragments to show a layered ledger, a two-way concept diagram and a plotted timing curve.

properties.label: Periwinkle and milky white
properties.text: Use pale periwinkle, milky white, blue-gray labels and restrained semantic accents.

properties.label: Layered instrument fragments
properties.text: Place fine-content fragments on multiple planes with slight translucency, giving each scene a specific explanatory drawing rather than a generic gradient rectangle.

properties.label: Buoyant translucent surfaces
properties.text: Use soft contact shadows and light translucency to make white fragments buoyant without generic giant drop shadows.

properties.label: Shared directional light
properties.text: Light all three scenes from one consistent direction.

properties.label: Contained instrument motion
properties.text: If used, keep tiny plotted runners or floating motion inside the scenes while descriptive text remains still; every scene retains a strong composed frame.

properties.label: Three-scene reflow acceptance
properties.text: Preserve all three features and their drawings through mobile reflow.
